payload.description:
As a scoring-platform consumer, I want the handler and container build definition to come from one immutable Plexus revision, so that the image I validate is the image implementation I deploy.

Feature: Immutable distributable score processor runtime

Scenario: Build from an installed Plexus distribution
Given a consumer installs an exact Plexus revision
When the consumer locates the score processor container build definition
Then the resource is present without a Plexus repository checkout
And the resulting handler entry point is importable from the installed package

Scenario: Reject an ambiguous source build
Given no immutable Plexus revision is supplied
When the container build is attempted
Then the build fails before producing a runnable image

Scenario: Preserve existing first-party builds
Given an existing score processor build uses the repository compatibility entry point
When it imports the Lambda handler
Then it resolves to the packaged handler implementation.
payload.title: Consumers build the runtime from one immutable package revision
